children: Notification of Admission of Further Securities to Trading (PRM 1.6.4R)

In accordance with The Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024 (POATRs) PRM 1.6.4R, SSE plc (the Company) notifies the market that 63 Ordinary Shares of 50p each fully paid have been admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange, as follows:
Details of the transferable securities admitted to trading
Ordinary Shares of 50p each fully paid
63 Shares issued on 27 Aug 2026 pursuant to the exercise of options under the Company's Irish SAYE Sharesave Scheme.
Total number of securities in issue following admission
1,215,474,718 Ordinary Shares (including 3,070,916 Ordinary Shares which are held in treasury).
Fully fungible with existing Ordinary Shares.
All admissions up to and including 1 September 2026.
